name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
oracle_text:
Flying, deathtouch
Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life. (Damage causes loss of life.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much life. (Damage causes loss of life.)

needs.what: a `life_lost` trigger event that fires once per instance of a player losing life, filterable by whose life it was (you / an opponent / each opponent), and which fires for every source of loss -- combat and noncombat damage, payment of life as a cost, and direct lose_life effects -- rather than only for damage
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `trigger_events` has `you_gain_life` (the exact mirror of this, so the plumbing exists in one direction only) and `dealt_damage`, but `dealt_damage` fires on a permanent being damaged, not on a player's life total dropping, so it would miss life paid as a cost and every `lose_life` effect while also firing on creature damage that costs no life at all

needs.what: a value key that reads the amount of life lost by the single triggering event, so "you gain that much life" can feed `gain_life` with the exact quantity from the trigger that just fired
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `life_lost_this_turn` is a cumulative per-turn total, so with two separate losses in a turn the second trigger would gain the sum instead of the increment; `binding` and `damage_taken_this_turn` likewise do not expose a per-trigger life-loss amount
